answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The velvet holds work receipts rather than names, so the raven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the nebula of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
